Name: Enchanted Cowboy Boots
Author: Goldenrevolver
Description:
[size=3][color=#6aa84f]If you like this mod, then you may also like its sibling mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20942]Enchanted Adventurer's Guild Rewards[/url].

Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6.2 and SMAPI 4.0.1. Source available on Github:[/color]
[url=https://github.com/Goldenrevolver/Stardew-Valley-Mods]https://github.com/Goldenrevolver/Stardew-Valley-Mods[/url]


This mod adds multiple ways to obtain the cowboy boots (which is an unobtainable base game item), and gives them a unique enchantment.

﻿[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/20941/20941-1711320990-1182023564.png[/img]

[b]Enchantment:
[/b]
These boots will boost your or your horses movement speed while running on dusty ground ﻿(dirt, sand, etc.). The strength of this effect can be configured in the config.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/20941/20941-1711300635-82215385.png[/img]

[b]How To Obtain:[/b]

You obtain these boots by first collecting 4 (configurable in the config) vanilla [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Hats]cowboy hats[/url]. If you then put them on one after another, the cowboy boots will magically appear.

Alternatively, if you won the cowboy arcade game [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Journey_of_the_Prairie_King]Journey of the Prairie King[/url] in the saloon, putting on a single cowboy hat will be enough to convince the boots to appear.


Requirements:
[url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]: I built version 1.0 of this mod based on version 4.0.1. It should be compatible with a few future versions and a few prior version. You can get the latest version of SMAPI [url=https://smapi.io/]here[/url].


Installation:
Install SMAPI. Then extract the content of the downloaded zip file into the SMAPI mods folder and start the game via the SMAPI launcher or Steam if you have set the launch option for SMAPI in Steam. The config file will be generated inside the folder of the mod. Close the game to edit it and restart the game.

You can also optionally use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿ to change the config ingame without the need to restart (otherwise you need to restart) but it is not required to be installed.


Updating: 
Simply delete the prior version, install the new one and check the updated config created after the first startup (Changes require restart to take effect if you have not made them with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]).


Uninstallation:
You can delete this mod from your mods folder at any time to remove the features. Since the boots are a base game item, you will keep them, but they will lose their movement speed buff.[/size]
